question.title: Which discovery will the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry be awarded for?
question.description: The 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry will be announced on 7 October 2026. The options represent 30 distinct discoveries or inventions that could plausibly be recognized by the prize, with the named researchers indicating the expected laureates for each contribution.
question.resolution_criteria: Resolves to the option whose discovery or invention most closely matches the official motivation for the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry published by NobelPrize.org. The people named after the dash do not form part of the resolution requirement. If none of the 30 discoveries matches the official motivation, the question is annulled. If the prize recognizes multiple distinct contributions, the contribution receiving the largest aggregate share of the prize determines the outcome; if equally divided, the contribution named first in the official announcement determines the outcome.
question.fine_print: Options are intended to represent distinct contributions rather than alternative formulations of the same discovery. Researchers are listed in expected order of Nobel recognition and only researchers believed to be living on 7 October 2026 are named.
